declarations.name: DeviceActivityReport

members.name: init
members.signature: @MainActor @preconcurrency init(_ context: DeviceActivityReport.Context, filter: DeviceActivityFilter = DeviceActivityFilter())
members.comment:
Creates a new device activity report.

If you do not specify a filter, then the system will provide all device activity data for the current user and the current device to your
device activity report app extension.

- Parameters:
    - context: The context of the report.
    - filter: A filter for the device activity data that your app extension will use to render the report.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityReport.Body
declarations.comment:
The type of view representing the body of this view.

When you create a custom view, Swift infers this type from your
implementation of the required ``View/body-swift.property`` property.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityReport.Context
declarations.comment:
A context indicating how your device activity report extension should configure its ``DeviceActivityReportView``.

You can use a ``Context`` to create a ``DeviceActivityReport``, which the system then provides to your app's extension
and allows it to configure the resulting report `View` in a particular way. For example, if you want to render either a pie chart or bar
graph representing the user's device activity, you can create the following custom contexts:

    extension DeviceActivityReport.Context {
        static let barGraph = Self("barGraph")
        static let pieChart = Self("pieChart")
    }

If your app instantiates a report with the `barGraph` context, then the system prompts your report extension to generate a
view using the ``Scene`` corresponding to that context.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityReportExtension
declarations.comment:
An app extension that reports device activity data.

Your extension is provided with the data that your app requests when it instantiates a `DeviceActivityReport`,
which it uses to render a <doc://com.apple.documentation/documentation/swiftui/view> representing
the user's device activity.

members.name: configuration
members.comment:
A shared implementation for your extension's scene configuration.

Your report extension should use this shared ``DeviceActivityReportExtension.configuration`` implementation
rather than providing its own.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityReportScene
declarations.comment:
Defines a custom device activity report scene.

This protocol refines `AppExtensionScene` and restricts the types that can be passed to a ``DeviceActivityReportBuilder``.
Your extension should provide a scene for each context that your app supports.

declarations.comment: An asynchronous sequence of filtered device activity results.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityResults.AsyncIterator
declarations.comment:
The type of asynchronous iterator that produces elements of this
asynchronous sequence.

declarations.name: DeviceActivityResults.Iterator
declarations.comment: An asynchronous iterator for filtered device activity.

globals.name: activitySegments
globals.comment:
The activity of the user divided into segments.

The length of each activity segment is dependent on the ``segmentInterval`` that your app requests via
a ``DeviceActivityFilter``.

globals.name: webDomains
globals.comment: The user's web domain activity that contributed to this category's ``totalActivityDuration``.

globals.name: applications
globals.comment: The user's application activity that contributed to this category's ``totalActivityDuration``.

globals.name: categories
globals.comment: The user's categorized device activity during the activity segment.

globals.name: makeAsyncIterator
globals.comment: Creates the asynchronous iterator that produces elements of this asynchronous sequence.

globals.name: next
globals.comment: Asynchronously advances to the next element and returns it, or ends the sequence if there is no next element.
